matches.rationale: The finding discusses normalization inconsistency between main text and appendix equations, but does not address the concatenation/summation confusion and index misalignment in Equation (3) that constitutes the ground truth defect.

The finding identifies the exact defect: main text equations use √d (correct feature dimensionality) while appendix uses √N_t (token length), and explicitly notes N_t is token length not feature dimension. This detects the scaling error described in gt_id 2, even though the finding reports it as an inconsistency between sections rather than as an error in the appendix alone.
The finding focuses on normalization scaling factors in attention equations, not on the inconsistent application of matrix B to the zero vector in Equation (13)'s cross-modal adaptation term.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Detects gt_id 2's incorrect use of √N_t instead of feature dimensionality in attention scaling.
